name: Telangana Rajiv Yuva Vikasam
teBrief: తెలంగాణలోని అర్హులైన యువత మరియు వెనుకబడిన తరగతుల (BC) అభ్యర్థుల స్వయం ఉపాధి కోసం ప్రతిపాదించబడిన రాష్ట్ర సబ్సిడీ సహాయ పథకం (అమలు కోసం వేచి ఉంది).
brief: Proposed Telangana State self-employment subsidy assistance programme for eligible youth and Backward Class applicants. Reported awaiting operational rollout — monitor official Telangana Government notifications.
sourceCredit: Source: Government of Telangana / Public Reporting
briefFull: Proposed Telangana State self-employment subsidy assistance programme for eligible youth and Backward Class applicants. Reported awaiting operational rollout — monitor official Telangana Government notifications.
details:
Rajiv Yuva Vikasam is a proposed self-employment subsidy assistance scheme announced by the Government of Telangana to support eligible unemployed youth, including Backward Class applicants, in establishing micro-enterprises and livelihood units through the Telangana State Welfare & BC Corporations.

> **Current Status Notice:** Operational rollout and final disbursement schedules have been reported pending. Prospective applicants should wait for official Telangana Government / BC Welfare Corporation operational notifications before paying any third party or relying on unofficial announcements.
benefits:
- Proposed self-employment financial assistance and subsidy tiers aimed at helping eligible youth start small business, trade or service units in Telangana.
- Final unit cost ceilings, subsidy percentages and sanction timelines are subject to official Government of Telangana operational orders.
eligibility:
1. Permanent residents of Telangana belonging to notified eligible categories (including Backward Classes).
2. Final age, annual family income and unit eligibility criteria will be governed strictly by official Telangana State BC Welfare Corporation notifications once operational rollout commences.
howToApply: Applications are accepted only when officially opened by the Government of Telangana / State BC Corporation through authorised state portals (such as TGBMMMS / official state portals). Do not submit fees or OTPs to unauthorised intermediaries.
documentsRequired:
- Valid Telangana BC Community Certificate (issued via MeeSeva / competent state authority)
- Income Certificate and Aadhaar Card
- Residence proof and Bank Account details
- Self-employment unit proposal / quotation as notified at rollout
